findings_summary: EDR alert EDR-2026-04127 on Finance endpoint FIN-WKS-0473 (user j.harlow) describes a classic macro-delivered malware chain: WINWORD.EXE spawned a hidden, base64-encoded PowerShell process that wrote and executed invoice_update.exe from the user's Temp directory, which then attempted to contact secure-doc-update.ru / 185.220.101.47. Enrichment strongly corroborates malicious intent: (1) The dropped file SHA256 is flagged malicious by 65 engines on VirusTotal (live, non-mock source). (2) The external C2 IP 185.220.101.47 scores 100/100 on AbuseIPDB with 93 reports (live, non-mock source) and geolocates to AS60729 (Stiftung Erneuerbare Freiheit), an operator associated with Tor/anonymization infrastructure. (3) The contacted domain is a lookalike '.ru' domain ('secure-doc-update') matching the social-engineering invoice lure; mock threat-intel and WHOIS data (6-day-old, privacy-proxy registration) further suggest newly-stood-up malicious infrastructure.
rationale: Two independent LIVE (non-mock) sources confirm malicious key indicators — VirusTotal (65/n engines malicious on the file hash) and AbuseIPDB (100/100, 93 reports on the C2 IP). The behavioral chain (Office macro -> hidden encoded PowerShell -> dropped EXE -> external callout to a lookalike .ru domain) is textbook initial-access/malware execution. This is a true positive on a high-value Finance workstation, not a false positive. AUTO_CLOSE criteria are not remotely met (no benign corroboration); this requires human incident response.
next_steps: Isolate/contain host FIN-WKS-0473 from the network pending IR review and confirm the EDR quarantine of invoice_update.exe held
Decode the base64 PowerShell command (-enc payload) to extract full execution and any additional download URLs/persistence
Hunt across the fleet for the file hash 275a021b... , the domain secure-doc-update.ru, and connections to 185.220.101.47
Reset credentials for user j.harlow and review their activity for compromise/lateral movement
Retrieve the originating Word document/email, identify other recipients of the phishing lure, and block sender/domain at the mail gateway
Add secure-doc-update.ru and 185.220.101.47 to network blocklists / proxy denylist
